column2: Once we find that loathsome secret underground organization's hideout,
my private army will wipe them out without a trace!
Do your best. The $$教団$$ is watching the work of your vigilante group with great interest!

I'll surely bring down Hell's hammer upon them!
And yet, the power $$嫉妬$$ brings forth really is magnificent!
Dance in Lord $$ユダ$$'s palm as much as you like!
(By the way... I wonder whether Lady $$ルカ$$'s side is going well.)
